# Acknowledgements {.unnumbered}

[Official McGill Guidelines](https://www.mcgill.ca/gps/thesis/thesis-guidelines/preparation):
Among other acknowledgements, the student is required to declare the extent
to which assistance (paid or unpaid) has been given by members of staff,
fellow students, research assistants, technicians, or others in the
collection of materials and data, the design and construction of apparatus,
the performance of experiments, the analysis of data, and the preparation
of the thesis (including editorial help).

- In addition, it is appropriate to recognize the supervision and advice
  given by the thesis supervisor(s) and advisors.
